about: Curated gallery for Ink Peaks / 卧游. lat/lon = refined crop centre (WGS84). radiusKm = half the side of the square, north-up crop. approx = centre originally proposed. china = mainland China: grid spacing >= 100 m, footprint-averaged (Chinese public-map rule; do not change). Bake with: python tools/bake_gallery.py destripe = remove N-S column stripes found in the source tiles (opt-in; would erase real N-S grain elsewhere).
